title_sq: DYQAN PER SHITJE TEK UNIVERS CITY!
description_sq:
Shesim dyqan ne nje nga godinat e reja ne kompleksin Univers City!
Ambjenti ka nje siperfaqe 58.13 m2 dhe organizohet ne nje hapesire te vetme dhe nje tualet.
Ka nje fasade lineare prej rreth 8 meter me vizibilitet maksimal.
Pozicionohet ne katin 0 te godines.
title_en: SHOP FOR SALE AT UNIVERS CITY!
description_en: We are selling a shop in one of the new buildings in the Univers City complex! The space has a surface of 58.13 m2 and is organized in a single space and a toilet. It has a linear facade of about 8 meters with maximum visibility. It is located on the 0th floor of the building.
